headline: Rackspace reportedly told customers leaked credentials let someone into Spot on Nov 17; not confirmed on a Rackspace page.
summary: First draft. 3 sources (2 Tier 1, 1 Tier 2), 11 claims (2 Confirmed, 5 Reported, 4 Not established), 5 questions. BleepingComputer, Nov 21, quotes Rackspace's customer notice: unauthorized access with leaked credentials, pods created, Kubernetes Secrets readable, admin console down for days, service restored Nov 21. Rackspace's own release notes and status page (Tier 1) do not mention a breach, so the hack stays Reported. Data theft, number of customers, attacker and how the credentials leaked are Not established. BleepingComputer was read through a fetch tool because the site blocks direct automated reading. Privacy check done: no names of people, no handles, no contact details.
